data.gender_notes: Marisella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name 'Maria' meaning 'bitter' and 'Sella' meaning 'chair'. The name Marisella can be translated to 'Sea of God' or 'Mary of God'. The name Marisella carries the meaning “Sea of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marisella usually hope their child will grow to embody sea of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Marisella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sea of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marisella total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Marisella
in_english.meaning: Daughter of Mary, blessed by God, gentle, kind, beautiful, virtuous, pure
in_english.long_meaning: Marisella - a name of Hebrew origin, derived from Mary, the mother of Jesus Christ. It signifies a daughter of Mary, blessed by God, gentle, kind, beautiful, virtuous, and pure. In the Christian tradition, the name Marisella is associated with the qualities of compassion, humility, and devotion.
